sanskrit: varcasvān asi deveṣu varcasvān oṣadhīṣv ā | atho varcasvinaṃ kṛdhi yam aśvatthādhirohasi ||
english: Splendorous art thou among the gods, splendorous among the plants. Now make splendorous the one upon whom, O Aśvattha, thou dost climb.

sanskrit: yam aśvattho adhyarukṣad rājā manuṣyaṃ janam | indram iva vi mṛdho hanat tasmād rāṣṭram anapacyutam ||
english: The Aśvattha has ascended over him who is king of the human folk. Like Indra he smites down foes; may the kingship not be dislodged from him.

sanskrit: āroho nāma vā asi sahasvān ud ajāyathāḥ | taṃ tvā sapatnasāsaham aśvattha bibharād ayam ||
english: Āroha by name thou art; thou hast arisen with might. May this man carry thee, O Aśvattha, crusher of rivals.

sanskrit: rājā vā asi bhūtānām ṛṣabho vīrudhāṃ patiḥ | sa naḥ sapatnān aśvattha viṣūco vy ud ā kṛdhi ||
english: Thou art king of all beings, the bull, the lord of plants. O Aśvattha, scatter our rivals asunder in all directions.

sanskrit: saṃpaśyamānā amṛtāya āyan śuddhā yonibhyas pari jāyamānāḥ | śivaṃ kṛṇvānā upa jighratemaṃ vīraṃ vīreṣv apy ā kṛṇudhvam ||
english: Looking upon one another they came for immortality, pure ones being born forth from their wombs. Making auspicious augury, smell this one here; place this hero among heroes.

sanskrit: śivo vo vīra iha jāto astu śuddho yonibhyas pari jāyamānaḥ | ariṣṭo 'yaṃ vardhatāṃ sarvam āyur varma jyāyobhyo haviṣā kṛṇotu ||
english: Auspicious for you let this hero be, born here, pure, born forth from the womb. May this one flourish unharmed with a full lifespan; may he make armor against his elders by oblation.

sanskrit: jarāṃ mṛtyuṃ prepsatu jīva eṣa nāsya krimir īśāto nota jambhaḥ | saṃrabhya jīva śaradaḥ suvarcā agniṣ ṭe gopā adhipā vasiṣṭhaḥ ||
english: May this living one reach old age and death by gradual measure; let no worm have power over him, nor tooth-decay. Taking hold of life, live the autumns in full splendor; Agni is thy guardian and highest protector, most excellent.

sanskrit: jarāmṛtyur jarāyur jarācakṣur jarāsvaḥ | jarase tvā jaradaṣṭiṃ pari dadāmi ||
english: Old-age death, old-age life, old-age sight, old-age horse — I surround thee with the lot of the old-gnawed, for old age.

sanskrit: dyauṣ ṭe pitā pṛthivī mātāntarikṣam ātmā | vātaḥ prāṇaḥ sūryaś cakṣur divas payaḥ | suparṇas tvābhy ava paśyād āyuṣe varcase 'yam annasyānnapatir astu vīraḥ ||
english: Heaven is thy father, Earth thy mother, the atmosphere thy self; Wind thy breath, the Sun thy eye, the milk of heaven thy nourishment. May the Suparṇa look down upon thee with favor, for long life and for brilliance; may this hero be the lord of food over food.

sanskrit: yajñasya cakṣuḥ prabhṛtir mukhaṃ ca vācā śrotreṇa manasā juhomi | imaṃ yajñaṃ vitataṃ viśvakarmaṇā- -ā devā yantu sumanasyamānāḥ ||
english: The eye of the sacrifice, its inaugural bringing-forth and its mouth — with voice, with hearing, with mind I offer. Let the gods come well-disposed to this sacrifice spread wide by Viśvakarman.

sanskrit: ye devānām ṛtvijo ye ca yajñiyā yebhyo havyaṃ kriyate bhāgadheyam | imaṃ yajñaṃ saha patnībhir etya yāvanto devās tati mādayantām ||
english: Those who are the seasonal priests of the gods, those who are worthy of worship, to whom the oblation is made as a portioned share — having come to this sacrifice together with their spouses, let all the gods rejoice throughout this spread.

sanskrit: yan mā hutaṃ yad ahutam ājagāma yasmād annān manasodrārajīmi | yad devānāṃ cakṣuṣa āgasīnam agniṣ ṭad dhotā suhutaṃ kṛṇotu ||
english: Whatever offered and whatever unoffered came to me, from which I keep my mind from straying on account of food — whatever sin committed in the sight of the gods, let Agni the hotar make that well-offered.

sanskrit: agneṣ ṭvā jihvayā hutam iṣṭaṃ marudbhir anumataṃ pitṛbhiḥ prāśnāmi ||
english: Offered upon the tongue of Agni, desired, approved by the Maruts — I partake of this with the Fathers.
